claim: First raw bits after an enable release from the stopped state, transistor level with injected trnoise, over many noise seeds (issue #216): across-seed agreement per sample index of the raw bit and of the four per-ring sampled bits, first window vs later windows, a noise-off negative control, and a cross-check against the phase-diffusion model; Ts = 100 ns compressed sampling
